product.description: Qualitative phase identification from powder X-ray diffraction data
product.copyright: Copyright (C) 2026 QualPF contributors; original QualX3 and third-party copyrights retained.

upstream.evidence: Original author commit explicitly updates LICENSE to GPLv3; upstream README still says LGPLv3.

historical_installer_license.disposition: Retained for provenance; excluded from installers and source deliveries. Its references to EXPO2013 and GTK do not establish a license for QualPF. Remaining upstream resource rights require review.

components.version: inherited source; provenance retained in Git
components.copyright: QualX3 contributors, IC-CNR; individual original notices retained
components.modifications: C++20 refactoring, Application workspace, QPF format, search/GUI and packaging changes recorded in Git and CHANGELOG.md
components.obligations: Preserve authorship, mark modifications/dates, provide corresponding source. This code-level evidence does not clear separately sourced data/artwork.

components.modifications: Local OBJECT target and include integration; upstream file notices retained
components.obligations: Use GPLv3 for the combined application; preserve both source headers and supply these sources.

paths: selected SDK libraries, plugins, translations and their embedded dependencies
components.version: per-build Qt SDK and its component SBOM
components.copyright: The Qt Company and Qt/embedded-component contributors; exact notices from the SDK
components.license: LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only; embedded components have individual terms
components.modifications: Deployment selection/layout; SDK binaries are not rebuilt by this task
components.obligations: Match every shipped library/plugin to SDK notices, exact source and build configuration; preserve component-specific notices, not only these generic texts.

paths: headers instantiated into product object code
components.copyright: Eigen contributors, with file-specific notices including Intel Corporation
components.modifications: External unmodified headers; no compile policy or numerical change
components.obligations: Review headers actually compiled; preserve file-specific notices and applicable source availability.

paths: Boost headers instantiated into product object code
components.version: actual version per build (local Windows SDK 1.82.0)
components.copyright: Boost contributors; retain the individual header notices
components.obligations: Record exact headers/version and retain required notices.

components.modifications: Frozen exact naming supplement and generated constraint table; original source notice preserved
components.obligations: Reproduce copyright, conditions and disclaimer in binary notices; no endorsement. Does not clear the other table sources.

paths: MinGW-w64 CRT/startup code linked into product and GCC runtimes
components.version: compiler-resolved runtime files and package-specific hashes
components.copyright: Free Software Foundation, MinGW-w64/winpthreads and respective contributors
components.license: component-specific GPL/runtime exceptions and MinGW-w64 terms
components.modifications: Unmodified compiler-resolved runtime files; deployment only
components.obligations: GCC 13.1.0 source acquired and verified; obtain the exact MinGW-builds patch/build scripts as well. Preserve MinGW CRT notices. Winpthreads has its own reviewed MIT/BSD notice, not the GCC exception.

components.version: MinGW-w64 v11; exact local SDK DLL identity recorded per payload
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011 mingw-w64 project; derived parts (C) 2010 Lockless Inc.
components.license: MIT and BSD-3-Clause notices in the supplied upstream COPYING
components.obligations: Retain both notices and disclaimers, with no endorsement. No copyleft source requirement is imposed by these MIT/BSD terms; record the exact SDK DLL rather than applying GCC runtime exceptions.

paths: MSVC runtime DLLs and vc_redist.x64.exe if shipped
components.version: selected MSVC toolset and actual redist package
components.obligations: Excluded from formal distribution by owner decision; MSVC remains a development/test kit. Historical audit packages remain evidence and are not release candidates.

components.source: selected QtIFW/AppImage/runtime releases and deployed dependencies
components.version: exact tool/runtime identities and hashes per artifact
components.license: component-specific; not inferred from the application license
components.modifications: Generated installer metadata and deployment layout; record any binary modifications such as RPATH edits
components.obligations: IFW 4.8.1 installerbase embeds Qt 6.6.0 and OpenSSL 3.0.14, separately from application Qt 6.8.3. Public versioned sources are acquired; exact static build inputs/configuration and all embedded notices remain to be bound. Review DirectX/software-renderer payloads independently.

components.source: Retained QualX3 tables, scientific references and frozen exact generator inputs
components.version: hash-pinned current scientific manifests; no numerical changes
components.copyright: Original table/data authors; independent redistribution scope not established by citations alone
components.license: unresolved for parts of the delivered tables; optional uncleared examples are excluded
components.modifications: Accepted generated C++ tables and preserved binary32/exact-rational semantics
components.obligations: Establish grants for AtomProperties.xen, syminfo.lib, scattering/NIST source tables and the exact symmetry catalogue. Optional powder examples and the reserved CIF are excluded from delivery; permission is needed if reintroduced. Preserve all accepted bytes while reviewing. Per-input findings and required owner information: deploy/rights-review.json and docs/developer/distribution-rights.md.

components.source: QualX3 and any external original asset authors
components.version: retained documentation assets; all 29 inherited action images removed from current source and delivery
components.copyright: Original asset/document authors; institutional marks are not QualPF marks
components.modifications: All inherited runtime action images replaced by independently drawn QualPF SVG masters and PNG exports; original identities retained in the rights review
components.obligations: Confirm grants for remaining delivered inherited documentation/assets. Removed action images are excluded, not relicensed; their original identities and replacement paths remain in deploy/rights-review.json.

components.source: QualPF contributors; preserved raster master/prompt and SVG masters
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 2026 QualPF contributors, to the extent applicable rights exist
components.modifications: Independent artwork and implementation; upstream and third-party notices remain separate
components.obligations: Preserve source/master inputs and modification dates; identify exact corresponding source.

source_inputs.test_only_archives: All other entries in the archive manifest: retained independent comparison evidence, excluded from source delivery and restored separately for normal regressions.
source_inputs.obligations: Include preferred modification inputs and generators in corresponding source after rights clearance; a successful compile of committed generated tables is not sufficient. Never regenerate scientific expected results from the product.

release_requirements: No blocked component rights remain unresolved.
Final staged files and installer/AppImage runtime have an exact package-specific provenance, notice and source review.
Binary and corresponding-source artifacts identify the same clean committed revision and carry SHA-256 checksums.
DEB Maintainer has a real supplied contact email, never an Issues URL or a fabricated address.
Only tested native platform/toolchain scopes are claimed; no publication is performed by the validation tools.

release_policy.basis: Owner decision on 2026-10-22: MinGW formal Windows distribution; retain MSVC for development validation. Pass the real DEB email explicitly; the CMake cache default stays empty.
